cohort: 66,678 births after 24 weeks' gestation from one tertiary hospital in Poland between 2010 and 2020
finding: While the overall cesarean birth rate in Poland increased significantly, the rate in the studied hospital remained lower than the national average, with no statistically significant increases in cesarean birth rates within any Robson Ten-Group Classification System group.
mod_finding: This study investigated cesarean birth rates and did not report on specific findings related to mode of delivery.
